resources.string: Select YouTube Music or another player in Tools → EQ for other apps. YouTube Music and YouTube are separate apps.
Allow notification access to display track titles and playback state. Only selected apps are shown. Notification bodies are not analyzed or saved.
If Android blocks this setting, open App info → menu → Allow restricted settings. Notification access is separate from ordinary notification permission and DUMP setup.
Could not open Android settings. Open notification access from device settings.
Playback information is unavailable. Check notification access and refresh.
No playback information from selected apps yet. Start a track, then refresh.
Playing on another device · phone EQ does not apply
EQ connection target · track information not received
No local track is loaded. Other apps use device EQ and are not included in Rust DSP measurements.
